title: FsStatus
description: State of the shared folder on this node: after the welcome (external mounts), after each fs.mount or fs.unmount, and whenever a health check finds the mount gone or back. mode daemon = the daemon runs the S3 mount client itself; external = mounted outside the daemon (Docker volume plugin, host service) at AGENT_TEAMS_FS_DIR. Unreliable (the latest state is what matters).

bucket.description: The bucket mounted (fs.mount bucket); absent for an external mount that does not know it.
